segments.sn22.67:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.67:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu … pe … ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
segments.sn22.67:1.4: “Yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo”ti.
segments.sn22.67:2.1: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī”ti?
segments.sn22.67:2.2: “Rūpaṃ kho, bhante, dukkhaṃ; tatra me chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.67:2.6: viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ; tatra me chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.67:2.7: Imassa khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī”ti.
segments.sn22.67:3.2: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
segments.sn22.67:3.3: Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu, dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.67:3.7: viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.67:3.8: Imassa kho, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti … pe …
segments.sn22.67:3.9: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.

lines: Sā hi taṇhāyanaṭṭhena taṇhā, chandikataṭṭhena chando.
Catutthaṃ aniccalakkhaṇamukhena vuttaṃ, pañcamaṃ dukkhalakkhaṇamukhena, chaṭṭhaṃ anattalakkhaṇamukhena.
